text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Debut race. Copano Rickey 
stepped out through the orange gate, her 
designated lucky color.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the paddock, she looks around and 
checks her compass just like a child—yet 
this is all a Feng Shui ritual to bring 
the entire field under her domain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What happens when the concept of feng shui 
is incorporated into running? That will 
become clear on the day of the actual 
race.
